trigger.description: A CASS view line exceeds the fixed 8 MiB capture limit, a source changes during capture, a retained source line changed or disappeared, or a legacy lossy excerpt cannot prove its complete source across screening versions. That session is preserved and later sessions continue importing.
setup_commands: # Revisit an unverifiable v0.17.0 excerpt, change a previously imported source line, or capture a transcript with a stdout line over 8 MiB.

expected_emission.repair_string: Inspect sessions[].refusalCode and sessions[].repair; restore original source evidence before retrying refused sessions.
